## Checklist

- [ ] `npm test` passes, with tests for new behaviour
- [ ] No new dependencies
- [ ] Tests use temp dirs only (never real `~/.zarvis` or `~/.claude`)
- [ ] No personal paths, emails or tokens
- [ ] UI changes: `render()` only rewrites `#list`, transform/opacity only, reduced-motion honoured, key map and tests intact, AA contrast
- [ ] README updated if behaviour changed
